sentences.text: Asterosteus was a member of the class Placodermi, an ancient group of armored fish.
This genus belongs to the family Asterosteidae and represents a specific type of rhenanid placoderm.
The type species, Asterosteus stenocephalus, is known from an incomplete skull found in Middle Devonian strata in Ohio.
A possible second species exists, known from fragments with star-shaped tubercles found in the Eifelian-aged Gebze beds of Turkey.
Newberry described the genus in 1875, establishing Asterosteus stenocephalus as the type species.
Fossils of this animal date to the Eifelian stage.
